description: The bar chart illustrates the GPU memory usage in gigabytes (GB) for various methods, with the y-axis representing GPU Memory (GB) on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, marked at intervals of 20. The x-axis lists six different methods: Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA, and Ours, with the "Ours" method highlighted in green while the others are shown in orange. The "Full FT" method requires the highest memory, at approximately 70 GB, followed by "MTL-FT" at around 40 GB. The "TAG" and "LoRA" methods both use approximately 25 GB, while "QLoRA" uses about 15 GB. The "Ours" method, represented by the green bar, uses approximately 25 GB of GPU memory, which is comparable to the "TAG" and "LoRA" methods. The bars are arranged in descending order of memory usage from left to right, with the exception of the "Ours" method, which is positioned last.
